Git: Wall time includes Git launcher and child; raw process CPU and peak-working-set counters are launcher-only. Summary engine memory is null, never zero.
OtherEngines: OS peak working set and CPU time of directly launched process; not allocations and not a whole-process-tree counter.
Unavailable: Git child-process CPU/memory, native binary coverage, PowerShell/shell line and branch coverage, Linux runtime validation, rendered layout, coverage-guided fuzzing.
